status: Accepted bounded offline startup, price publication and packaged-font checkpoint; full settings durability and overall release remain open.

independentReview.verdict: Accept the bounded offline startup, owned price publication and packaged-font checkpoint at the pinned source; OFF10 remains open and required before release. This is not overall production readiness or a clean-console claim.

sourceReview.findings: OFF1–OFF9 bounded source corrections reviewed; OFF10 explicitly open.

evidenceAssessment: Read raw full-v4 log: 296 test files passed, 2 skipped; 3192 tests passed, 18 skipped. Focused-v12: 54 tests in 9 files. Type/lint v7 empty successful logs are parent-reported commands, not an independent repeat.

Inspected browser-v5 harness and raw report. Runtime.enable attaches before resuming the newly paused extension worker. Both owned current worker sessions have zero exceptionThrown events; copied prior/other worker retains two events separately. Observation is bounded to blocked-DNS startup and roughly 18 seconds after subscriptions, not arbitrary future/reconnect behavior.

Both profiles answer price/network subscriptions, show enabled extension and one-minute registry retry alarm; 13 copied and 1 fresh protected-record hashes unchanged. Real external providers and live transactions are excluded.

Inspected font audit and exact ZIP bytes: each packaged build uses local font files, no inlined font data in packaged CSS; both JetBrains Cyrillic-ext and Vietnamese face loads succeed in compiled browser report. CSP policy remains unchanged.
Independently compared every one of 314 entries in each Chrome and Firefox archive against frozen build-file hashes, plus archive size and SHA. All match.

Read production Chrome audit/popup, Firefox runtime/smoke and exact warning logs: production popup ready; Firefox 152.0.4 popup and dynamic-Function CSP test pass, 41-warning fingerprint unchanged. Runtime binary/distribution identity and cleanup evidence are pinned; this is local unsigned smoke, not signed AMO acceptance.
remainingGates: OFF10: Explicit network edits during an unreadable-cache interval currently mutate memory but cannot persist, and repair can overwrite them. Add queued per-field intent or a truthful unavailable result before release; this checkpoint does not claim full network preference durability.
General network settings write acknowledgements, network callback ownership and mixed-worker behavior are not fully qualified.
Public provider reconnect/live service interoperability, complete screen/accessibility/brand rollout, final historical upgrade/private-chain checks and signed distribution remain open.
Native automatic JSON modal sequencing/Profile authentication, Android imported-wallet navigation, physical hardware and cross-platform release acceptance remain open.
additionalLimits: No duplicate whole-suite or external browser execution during this review; acceptance uses independently hashed source, archives and raw existing evidence.
Expected blocked-provider WebSocket errors and Vue/router/keyring warnings remain in raw logs. Zero current-worker uncaught exceptions does not mean a clean console.
No physical device, signed distribution, Linux CI, historical Firefox wallet upgrade, network-settings acknowledgement or real-provider reconnect qualification.
